column3: “He was accompanied by” expands the coordination of Rezin and Pekah; overpowering the city renders fighting against it.
“Feeds” specifies the relation of the aqueduct to the pool.
“Stand firm in your faith” expands the verb “believe”; “at all” is added.
“Virgin” specifies the young woman named in the Hebrew.
Flies and bees are plural instead of collective singulars; “Nile” specifies the Egyptian streams.
“Euphrates” identifies “the River”; the possessives are supplied.
“Raise” renders keeping alive; “sheep” specifies the small livestock.
“Shekels” names the implied silver units; “only” is added.
